$comment: Accepted mutants of tools/relay_mutation_gate.py that are by design or recorded follow-ups. Each entry names one route (no pattern) and lists its paths; `mutation` and each `path` are fnmatch patterns (`*` spans path separators), and a path of wildcards only is refused. The most specific entry matching a finding lists it (a literal path first). An entry that matches no finding fails the gate. Follow-ups are listed in docs/merge-tooling.md.
